metadata.title: COSU Security Viewing / Monitoring Console SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Security Viewing and Monitoring Consoles used for non-administrative situational awareness and security observation.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to viewing and monitoring security-related information such as camera feeds, alarms, and access events, without administrative or configuration privileges.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Security Viewing Consoles inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for non-administrative security monitoring.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved security monitoring, video viewing, and alert dashboards with read-only access.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Authorized security personnel authenticate by role; no persistent local user profiles are retained.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Security Viewing Consoles are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Security Viewing Consoles are centrally enrolled, configured, monitored, and recovered.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for network trust, integrity verification, and secure communications with security platforms.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables administrative tools, shell access, removable media, web browsing, and non-security applications.

props.name: privilege-boundary
props.remarks: Security Viewing Consoles must not support configuration, system administration, user management, or forensic extraction functions.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is restricted to approved security monitoring platforms, camera systems, alarm systems, logging endpoints, and management services.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Video, logs, and security event data must not be stored locally on the console beyond transient display buffers.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Security Viewing Consoles may interact with limited operational security data but not sensitive investigative or classified datasets.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: A security viewing console does not imply eligibility for security system administration or higher endpoint trust tiers.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Security Viewing Consoles must prioritize uninterrupted operation and rapid recovery to maintain situational awareness.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Console health, access attempts, configuration drift, and tamper events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Security Viewing Consoles support auditable provisioning, reset, and retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Security Viewing Consoles implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on read-only access, integrity of situational awareness, and strong privilege separation.

roles.title: Security Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for monitoring, response coordination, and situational awareness using Security Viewing Consoles.

roles.title: Physical Security Governance
roles.remarks: Approves monitoring scope, data visibility boundaries, and console use policies.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Ensures security posture, monitoring, and lifecycle governance for Security Viewing Consoles.

control-implementation.remarks: Security Viewing Console implementations may use hardened workstations, dedicated video wall controllers, or embedded appliances and are maintained as controlled configuration baselines aligned with this SSPP.
